notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 59-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.42, creatinine 0.79, hemoglobin 14.5, platelets 225, sodium 140, wbc 6.5; vitals dbp 67-71, heart_rate 80-82, map 85-88, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 120-124, spo2 93-94, temp 36.8-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. COPD. Hypertension.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.79, hemoglobin 14.5, platelets 221, sodium 141, wbc 7; vitals dbp 66-71, heart_rate 79-83, map 84-89, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 119-124, spo2 93-95, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. COPD. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 59-year-old male, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. COPD. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week.
